short: Hypoxia-mimicking mesoporous bioactive glass scaffolds with
title: Hypoxia-mimicking mesoporous bioactive glass scaffolds with controllable cobalt ion release for bone tissue engineering

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Bone scaffolds should give a hypoxia-like pro-angiogenic cue. Co2+ incorporated into MBG scaffolds with controllable release should mimic hypoxia in BMSCs.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/synthesis), n14 (PRC/treatment)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Co is incorporated into the scaffolds: Co/Ca 0 (MBG), 0.14 (2Co-MBG), 0.49 (5Co-MBG). 2Co- and 5Co-MBG keep an ordered mesoporous channel structure (pores ~4-5 nm).
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/chemistry/composition), n8 (STR/phase/identity), n9 (STR/microstructure/porosity). Premises: A type IV N2 isotherm with a hysteresis loop indicates mesopores; A small-angle XRD reflection at 2theta ~1-2 deg indicates periodic mesostructure

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Co2+ in place of Ca2+ perturbs the ordered orientation of mesopore channels during self-assembly. Co2+ release is set by Co content: 5Co-MBG releases faster and more than 2Co-MBG, both rising over 7 days.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (MEC/pathway), n11 (PRP/value), n12 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value), n15 (PRP/value). Premises: Co2+ stabilises HIF-1alpha under normoxia, mimicking hypoxia and inducing VEGF

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Ampicillin-loaded 2Co-MBG lowers bacterial survival versus blank and drug-free scaffolds

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Co-MBG scaffolds combine controllable Co2+ release, hypoxia-mimicking VEGF/HIF-1alpha induction in BMSCs and local antibiotic delivery for bone repair

nodes.title: TEM, F4
nodes.head: TEM: parallel channel stripes over ~200 nm in a and a regular pore lattice in b, period ~5-6 nm
nodes.solves: 2Co- and 5Co-MBG keep an ordered mesoporous channel structure (pores ~4-5 nm)
nodes.note: packet F4 is paper Fig. 3; pore diameter alone is not resolvable from wall at this scale; MBG not imaged
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o3, o4, o6 after removal.

nodes.title: XRD, F2
nodes.head: Small-angle XRD: one low-angle reflection in all three patterns, at 2theta ~1.37 (MBG), ~1.47 (2Co) and ~1.35 deg (5Co)
nodes.solves: 2Co- and 5Co-MBG keep an ordered mesoporous channel structure (pores ~4-5 nm)
nodes.note: linked text gives 2theta 1.25-1.30 deg; plotted peaks sit at ~1.35-1.5 deg
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o4, o5, o6 after removal.

nodes.title: DIFF, F2
nodes.head: Low-angle peak height falls ~8-fold with Co: ~180000 (MBG), ~74000 (2Co), ~23000 (5Co), 5Co peak barely above the rising background
nodes.solves: 2Co- and 5Co-MBG keep an ordered mesoporous channel structure (pores ~4-5 nm)
nodes.note: linked text calls all three peaks 'obvious'
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o3, o5, o6 after removal.

nodes.title: EDS:spectrum, F1
nodes.head: EDS: no Co peak with Co/Ca = 0 in b; Co peak near 6.9 keV in d and f, labelled Co/Ca = 0.14 and 0.49
nodes.solves: Co is incorporated into the scaffolds: Co/Ca 0 (MBG), 0.14 (2Co-MBG), 0.49 (5Co-MBG)
nodes.note: Ca Ka peak shrinks relative to Si from b to f; Co peak is small in both d and f
nodes.detail: o1: EDS: no Co peak with Co/Ca = 0 in b; Co peak near 6.9 keV in d and f, labelled Co/Ca = 0.14 and 0.49
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n7 (o1).

nodes.title: PHYS:surfacearea, F3
nodes.head: N2 isotherms of all three show a hysteresis step at P/P0 ~0.45-0.6 (type IV)
nodes.solves: 2Co- and 5Co-MBG keep an ordered mesoporous channel structure (pores ~4-5 nm)
nodes.detail: o6: N2 isotherms of all three show a hysteresis step at P/P0 ~0.45-0.6 (type IV)
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o3, o4, o5 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: N2 uptake at P/P0 ~1 falls with Co: ~8.7 (0Co), ~5.6 (2Co), ~4.35 mmol/g (5Co). Pore-size distribution peaks at ~5 nm for 0Co and 2Co (2Co lower) and at ~4.2 nm for 5Co
nodes.solves: Co lowers mesoporosity: surface area 290 to 180 and 127 m2/g, pore volume 0.30 to 0.19 and 0.15 cm3/g
nodes.note: y axis is labelled 'Pore volume (mmol/g)'; x 34.7 cm3/mol liquid N2 gives 0.30, 0.19, 0.15 cm3/g, matching the Table 1 pore volumes in text
nodes.detail: o7: N2 uptake at P/P0 ~1 falls with Co: ~8.7 (0Co), ~5.6 (2Co), ~4.35 mmol/g (5Co); o8: Pore-size distribution peaks at ~5 nm for 0Co and 2Co (2Co lower) and at ~4.2 nm for 5Co
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n9 (o7, o8).

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: 5Co-MBG has the tallest, narrowest pore-size peak (dV/dD ~0.016 vs ~0.0107 for MBG, FWHM ~1.5 vs ~5 nm)
nodes.solves: Co2+ in place of Ca2+ perturbs the ordered orientation of mesopore channels during self-assembly
nodes.note: a narrower mesopore distribution at the highest Co level does not fit a Co-induced channel-disorder reading
nodes.detail: o9: 5Co-MBG has the tallest, narrowest pore-size peak (dV/dD ~0.016 vs ~0.0107 for MBG, FWHM ~1.5 vs ~5 nm)
nodes.inner_audit: o9: a narrower mesopore distribution at the highest Co level does not fit a Co-induced channel-disorder reading

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: Co2+ in medium: 5Co ~8.9/17.9/20.8 and 2Co ~4.7/10.5/16.9 mg/L at 1/3/7 days; 0Co stays at 0
nodes.solves: Co2+ release is set by Co content: 5Co-MBG releases faster and more than 2Co-MBG, both rising over 7 days
nodes.detail: o10: Co2+ in medium: 5Co ~8.9/17.9/20.8 and 2Co ~4.7/10.5/16.9 mg/L at 1/3/7 days; 0Co stays at 0
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n11 (o10).

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: 2Co-MBG SiO4 release peaks at ~102 mg/L on day 3 and falls to ~83 by day 7, while MBG and 5Co-MBG reach ~192
nodes.note: Ca reading moved here by judge (F5c, not cited): 5Co Ca ends ~97 vs ~120 mg/L; Ca of MBG and 5Co first drops (73 to ~44 and ~56 mg/L at day 1); PO4 (F5d) falls from ~88 to 35-49 mg/L
nodes.detail: o11: 2Co-MBG SiO4 release peaks at ~102 mg/L on day 3 and falls to ~83 by day 7, while MBG and 5Co-MBG reach ~192
nodes.necessity_reason: n12 keeps shown support from o16 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F8, F9
nodes.head: 5Co-MBG VEGF secretion (~115 pg/mL) is not above MBG (~100), although 5Co releases the most Co2+. HIF-1alpha band faint for MBG and 2Co-MBG, clearly stronger for 5Co-MBG; alpha-tubulin bands equal
nodes.solves: Released Co2+ acts as a hypoxia mimic, raising HIF-1alpha in BMSCs, which drives VEGF
nodes.op: compare across conditions, cross check consistency
nodes.note: set against F5a (highest Co2+ from 5Co) and F9 (strongest HIF-1alpha band for 5Co) 2Co band is no stronger than MBG; only 5Co shows an increase; single blot, no densitometry
nodes.detail: o16: 5Co-MBG VEGF secretion (~115 pg/mL) is not above MBG (~100), although 5Co releases the most Co2+; o17: HIF-1alpha band faint for MBG and 2Co-MBG, clearly stronger for 5Co-MBG; alpha-tubulin bands equal
nodes.inner_audit: o16: set against F5a (highest Co2+ from 5Co) and F9 (strongest HIF-1alpha band for 5Co)
nodes.necessity_reason: Changes support for S2: o17 partial

nodes.title: evidence, F10
nodes.head: VEGF relative expression: blank ~3.5, MBG ~3.2, 2Co ~17.5, 5Co ~21.9 (P<0.05 vs MBG)
nodes.solves: Co-MBG raises VEGF gene expression of BMSCs at day 7 over MBG and blank
nodes.detail: o18: VEGF relative expression: blank ~3.5, MBG ~3.2, 2Co ~17.5, 5Co ~21.9 (P<0.05 vs MBG)
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n13 (o18).

nodes.title: ASSAY:stain, F11
nodes.head: Cumulative drug release ~340 ug at 8 h, ~670 at 24 h, ~780 at 72 h, ~795 ug at 168 h (plateau). ~84% of the 168-h released amount (~670 of ~795 ug) is out by 24 h
nodes.solves: 2Co-MBG releases ampicillin over the first ~72 h, then the release plateaus
nodes.note: error bars +/-110-130 ug; loaded amount not in packet release is burst-dominated; 'sustained over 72 h' covers only the last ~15%
nodes.detail: o20: Cumulative drug release ~340 ug at 8 h, ~670 at 24 h, ~780 at 72 h, ~795 ug at 168 h (plateau); o21: ~84% of the 168-h released amount (~670 of ~795 ug) is out by 24 h
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n15 (o20, o21).

nodes.title: ASSAY:survival, F11
nodes.head: Relative survival with Scaffolds+Ampicillin ~105, ~81, ~52% at days 1, 3, 7 vs blank 100 and drug-free scaffolds 110-118%
nodes.solves: Ampicillin-loaded 2Co-MBG lowers bacterial survival versus blank and drug-free scaffolds
nodes.note: drug-free 2Co-MBG does not reduce survival (110-118%), so no antibacterial effect of the Co scaffold itself
nodes.detail: o22: Relative survival with Scaffolds+Ampicillin ~105, ~81, ~52% at days 1, 3, 7 vs blank 100 and drug-free scaffolds 110-118%
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n16 (o22).

nodes.title: SEM, F1, F6
nodes.head: SEM: the three scaffolds show the same open network of thin-walled interconnected macropores. SEM: single spread cells with processes on pore walls in all six panels; dense filopodia clear in e, cell in a barely distinguishable
nodes.note: by the 200 um bar (~120 px) most openings measure ~100-250 um; few reach the 300-500 um stated in text one cell per field at 3000x; no cell density can be read; F6c scale OCR '500um' is the 50.0 um bar
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and n17 keeps shown support from o13, o15.

nodes.title: evidence, F10, F7, F8
nodes.head: MTT absorbance day 7: blank ~0.40 > MBG ~0.175 ~ 2Co ~0.152 (p>0.05) > 5Co ~0.108 (p<0.05); day 1 all 0.06-0.14. ALP activity: blank ~0.092, MBG ~0.080, 2Co ~0.056, 5Co ~0.055 OD/min/ug protein, p>0.05 among scaffolds.
nodes.note: error bars overlap; Co scaffolds' means sit ~40% below blank, and no scaffold-vs-blank test is marked, against 'comparable with blank control' in text 2Co error bar reaches ~560 pg/mL 2Co error bar spans ~0.4-1.58
